messages:
Sam: Quick postmortem follow-up from the 02:05 UTC surge. Need owners for headroom plan, scheduler tuning, tenant quota backstops, and a weekly audit. Keep replies short.
Talia: I can lead headroom + routing. Will propose cluster targets and cost delta by 2025-06-25.
Ben: I'll take scheduler changes. Short-term: per-node slot bump for small-model requests (8->11) behind a flag. PR ETA 2025-06-23.
Rita: I'll own tenant quotas. Plan: per-tenant token-bucket + emergency throttle and alerts. PR ETA 2025-06-22.
sre-bot: Incident summary: scheduler queue growth + headroom starvation at 02:05 UTC; peak GPU util ~98%; fallback rate ~23%.
Sam: Policy question: small baseline headroom (10-12%) for critical routes vs aggressive autoscale. Thoughts?
Talia: prefer modest headroom (12%) for critical routes and route heavy tenants to Dedicated when possible.
Ben: For scheduler, canary 3-5% traffic for 2h. Monitor gpu_utilization, scheduler_queue_len, preemption_rate, fallback_rate.
Rita: Quota snippet:
```yaml
per_tenant:
  burst: 320
  refill_per_sec: 32
  max_concurrent: 140
alerts:
  sustained_pct: 70
```
Sam: Recurring pattern: headroom erosion roughly every 21 days tied to batch windows. Ops rotation needs weekly audit. opsbot: create task?
opsbot: Created task #CI-8400 "weekly-headroom-audit" assigned ops-rotation; first run 2025-06-26.
Talia: I'll run first audit and report back here.
Ben: I'll add a 10m 80% sustained smoke test to CI and wire canary dashboards.
Rita: PR for token-bucket opened: https://git.internal/r/6789 - requesting review from @Ben @Talia
Ben: Draft scheduler PR: https://git.internal/r/6790 - includes feature flag and metrics.
Sam: Owners recap + due dates: Talia (headroom + routing) 2025-06-25; Ben (scheduler PR + canary) 2025-06-23; Rita (quota PR + alerts) 2025-06-22.
Sam: After merges: 2h canary verification, 6h post-rollout soak. Update thread with PR/merge links. Closing for now, reopen if blockers. :thumbsup:
